name: Joint Loss for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Denoising
definition: A composite objective function used in the second round of training to refine denoised images, balancing low-frequency agreement with high-frequency fidelity to enhance detail sharpness and texture fidelity while preserving structural consistency.
summary: The Joint Loss refines sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting denoising by balancing coarse tone preservation with fine detail restoration, preventing over-sharpening and color shifts.
